technology_name: Rainfall Insights Dashboard: HYDRAH Data Visualization Tool
institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
problem_solved: Lack of accessible, interactive tools to explore and analyze rainfall trends, patterns, and extreme events in tropical regions.
description: The HYDRAH (Hydrological Rainfall Analysis for Humid Tropics) dashboard is an interactive data visualization tool developed using the Shiny package in R. It enables the exploration of rainfall data to analyze long-term trends, anomalies, and extreme events in humid tropical regions. The intuitive interface features dedicated tabs for rainfall overviews, seasonal analysis using time series plots and histograms, and a statistical summary that identifies extreme precipitation. Designed for researchers and planners, the platform supports flood risk assessment, water resource management, and climate resilience strategies through data-driven insights.
applications:
• Integration into government flood risk assessment and climate resilience planning frameworks

• Deployment by environmental agencies for high-level hydrological research and monitoring

• Water resource management and infrastructure planning by municipal authorities

• Academic and scientific analysis of extreme precipitation events and seasonal shifts
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
